L'essentiel en un coup d'œil : un petit: The essentials at a glance: a small widget holds just one.
Un petit widget en contient un seul. Pou: A small widget holds just one widget. To combine several, choose Medium or Large in “Size”.
Un widget moyen réunit 2 widgets au plus: A medium widget combines 2 widgets at most. To combine up to 4, choose Large in “Size”.
En grand, 2 widgets réunis doivent exist: In Large, 2 combined widgets must each exist in medium: pick another widget, or another size in “Size”.
